x-bump-note: 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 adds the optional nullable top-level scalar `deliverable_id`, the join key attaching a problem-set to the REACH deliverable spine — problem-sets previously had no join key onto it at all. Shape mirrors completion-entry.schema.json's `deliverable_id` verbatim: anyOf [string, null], no pattern, no cross-field rule. Deliberately OPEN/ADVISORY rather than required-when: /shape ratifies a problem-set BEFORE any solution exists, so the spine id frequently does not exist at ratification time and null is the expected authoring-time value, not a defect; requiring it would gate ratification on downstream identity the ceremony has not produced yet. This schema carries no cross-field rules by design — `estimated_horizon`'s description routes that enforcement to /shape skill logic, not this validator — and an advisory join key is not worth being the first exception. LANDING ORDER: project-makima vendored FIRST, deliberately and correctly. A nested-field-additive bump holds unconditionally on the x-schema-version axis (coordinator/docs/wiki/schema-version-gate.md), so a DoE-first land would have redded THEIR suite until they caught up — the reverse edge Resolution 4 forbids. This entry is the canonical-side declaration catching up to that vendor-first land, closing the version-drift red in coordinator/tests/test_vendored_schema_version_parity.py. Origin: roadmap stub sedge-20, whose 'problem-set.schema.json is not in makima's vendored set, so this is genuinely one-way' premise was FALSE and was corrected by cross-repo/inbox/2026-08-11-doe-claude-em-problem-set-deliverable-id-is-vendored-vendor-first.md.
description: Problem-set — ratified problem statement authored via /shape before any solution; plans cite these as the external coverage oracle.

title.description: Human-readable label for the problem set.

date.description: Date the problem set was authored (YYYY-MM-DD).

ratified_by.description: Agent or human who ratified the problem statement.

ratified_date.description: Date the problem set was ratified (YYYY-MM-DD).

estimated_horizon.description: Work horizon estimated at ratification time. session=one or two sessions; week=roughly a week of work; initiative=weeks-to-quarters, multi-goal scope. Set by /shape at convergence; read by the altitude-router to select the correct downstream ceremony (plan | roadmap-planning | goal-setting). Note: cross-field routing from horizon to ceremony type is enforced by the /shape skill logic, NOT by this schema validator — no cross-field rule is present here and that is intentional.

deliverable_id.description: Durable deliverable join key attaching this problem-set to the REACH deliverable spine. OPEN/ADVISORY, never required-when: /shape ratifies a problem-set before any solution exists, so the spine id frequently does not exist yet at ratification time and null is the expected authoring-time value, not a defect. Populated later by whatever downstream ceremony mints the deliverable. Shape mirrors completion-entry.schema.json's `deliverable_id` verbatim.
